name: London, England
clues: Look for a platform between 9 and 10 that only wizards can find. Everyone else just sees a busy train station in my city. Where am I?
The Hogwarts Express leaves from King's Cross station, in the capital of England.
The capital of the United Kingdom, on the River Thames.
fact: King's Cross station has a luggage trolley 'vanishing' into the wall at Platform 9¾ for fans to pose with.

name: Paris, France
clues: Anyone can cook! A rat hid under a chef's hat and became the best cook in my city. Where am I?
Remy works in a fancy restaurant in this French capital, the city of the Eiffel Tower.
fact: The dish ratatouille comes from Provence, in the south of France.

name: Scottish Highlands
clues: Merida shot for her own hand and turned her mum into a bear. Her kingdom of misty highlands, castles and lochs is on a real map. Where am I?
Brave takes place in this country at the north end of Great Britain.
The northern part of the United Kingdom.
fact: Merida is voiced by Scottish actress Kelly Macdonald.
